datum.how: Two ties to the exterior that do not share a number: the windscreen's band against the side windows puts the seat mat at 1.07-1.13 above the road; the hull's outer roof, no higher than about 2.25 m in g011-a and nearly flat in g026-a, less the lining, less the roof's height over the aisle, puts the aisle at 0.68-0.77. So the mat stands about 0.36 above the aisle, and the footwell, 0.32 below the mat, is at the aisle's own level: one hull floor with a deck across it. g083-b's seam shows only that the mat is level with the plates just aft of it. The deck's height above the aisle is +-0.08; the compartment keeps its own z (aisle 0.62) and stands 0.10 higher on the hull when the real exterior is placed (X2).
